note: Reconstructed from the saved results in commit 9ee502e, then renamed to the places. Each side renders one cell whichever of its two places is occupied, on both sides: the reference marks it `data-geist-input-prefix` / `data-geist-input-suffix` and ours classes it `.start` / `.end`. Only the ground and the hairline differ between an add-on and an in-field place, and the wrapper carries that. `textParts` covers the three parts whose width follows their own text, which is set in our own font. `previews` names the seven examples both pages share: the reference's previews 3 and 4 are its SearchInput examples, which our docs page renders as acme-search on its own page, so reading them here would pair 22 reference roots against our 20 and misalign every comparison after example 2. The `svg` part is read inside its cell on the reference, because one of its roots (its suffixContainer={false} example) puts an icon straight in the wrapper with no cell at all, at 24x16 against the 14x14 every cell icon reads. Ours renders a cell either way, so that root has no counterpart and the part is skipped there rather than compared against a different shape.
